item.tib: skyabs rje mkhas btsun sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa gyer chen zla med dngos gzugs bzod pa'i mtshan bla med mdzad 'phrin rnam thar chu zla'i tshul skal bzang dad mos yid kyi bdud rtsi
item.coloph: zhes bla ma'i rnam par thar pa 'di yang mdo smad rong chen nyag yul bshad sgrab bon gling 'du gnas bsgom (sgom) sde chen po 'od gsal bde chen 'bar ba'i gling khrod nas/ dam pa khyung gi gdung las grol zhing bya btang rus skyes sprul ming 'dzin pa tshe dbang 'gyur med 'bod pa/ shar rdza'i ston pa chen po grub dbang rin po che'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len cing / 'chi med rig 'dzin gsang sngags gling pa'i rjes slob rgyal theb dbang bskyar smin pa'i rjes gnang thob pa gang gis thun mtshams su gus pas brtson pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo'i zla tshes nas sug bris bgyis pas/ rgyal dbang bla ma rnams kyi byin brlabs (rlabs) yon tan ma lus bdag sogs 'gro la 'char te/ snga 'gyur g.yung drung bon gyi bstan dang bstan 'dzin srid mtha'i bar du nub med dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru shog cig/
